6801.en: Let A′B′C′ be the anticevian triangle of X_54. Let A″ be the reflection of A′ in BC, and define B″ and C″ cyclically. The triangles ABC and A″B″C″ are cyclologic. See `Hyacinthos 23162 <http://www.hyacinthos.epizy.com/message.php?msg=23162>`__ (March 19, 2015, Randy Hutson, César Lozada)
